name: TriviaQA
intro: TriviaQA 是技术报告中常见的开放域问答评测，用于衡量模型回答事实型 trivia 问题的能力。
build_method: 知识问答站收集, Web与Wikipedia远程监督, 人工验证
build_method_en: Trivia-site collection, Web/Wikipedia distant supervision, human verification
intro_en: TriviaQA is a common open-domain QA benchmark in technical reports for measuring factual trivia question answering.

drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:1705.03551. TriviaQA gathers questions and answers from 14 trivia and quiz-league sites and drops questions shorter than four tokens. Each question is sent to Bing without its answer; the top 50 URLs are filtered and the top 10 pages crawled. TAGME-linked entities add Wikipedia pages as a second evidence domain. Documents lacking the correct answer string are removed for distant supervision, yielding 95,956 QA pairs, 662,659 evidence documents, about 650K Web examples, and 78K Wikipedia examples. QA pairs are split 80/10/10, and human-answerable Dev/Test subsets are published. EM and word F1 accept Wikipedia aliases, operate at question level for Wikipedia and document level for Web.
